body:
## Summary

Agents holding a lease must heartbeat and renew while a long command (test suite, image build) runs. `corvint-tasks` offers `attempt heartbeat` and `renew` but nothing that does this around a command, so every orchestration writes its own guard script in the agent's shell. In a multi-agent program these ad-hoc guards repeatedly failed: shell/Python syntax errors in generated guard code (the command then never ran), guards that outlived the command, and missed beats that let the lease expire mid-run and fenced the hand-off (`FENCED`, then the lane stayed allocated until reap).

## Request

Add a command such as `corvint-tasks run --attempt ID --generation G --timeout SECONDS [--lease-minutes N] -- COMMAND...` that:
- heartbeats before, during (default every ~4 min) and after, and renews so the lease covers the timeout plus cleanup;
- runs the command in its own process group and kills the group on timeout or when a beat/renew is refused (fenced/expired);
- returns the command's exit status with distinct codes for timeout and lost lease, and records a receipt of the outcome.

## Evidence

2026-10-02, native queue with ~10 concurrent agents: two review/integrate sessions ended with "bounded runner failed before executing: SyntaxError" in their own guard code, and earlier BT-002 attempts expired mid-Playwright and had release refused as FENCED. We now ship a small external wrapper (a stdlib script with tests), which suggests this belongs in the queue tool.

Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/481
Observed baseline: installed Tasks build 202; official channel tasks-dev-20260929.2. Disposable missing-capability proof /private/tmp/runner481-red-proof.json rejects attempt mode before command launch. Public implementation proposal base 1fda1b94984245d0cd0ac0a6d17cc72572ce6619. This is requested capability, not a confirmed existing implementation defect. No claim, product implementation, enrollment or gate is authorized until coordinating root admits the concrete private proposal. Required process-owner API source 1a355ea551c2745d3fe9f229a36acc348cb205d8 is not present in primary/shared-object leaf; public issue476 delivery remains dependency. Initial technical profile is proposed and must be accepted before delivery.
title: Tasks attempt command runner: fenced heartbeat, renewal, owned cleanup and outcome receipt
